item.tib: rnam dag rin chen gtsang ma'i klu 'bum dkar nag khra gsum 'dus pa
rnam dag rin chen gtsang ma'i klu'i 'bum dkar nag khra gsum 'dus pa
item.coloph: klu rgyal dga' bde dang / klu bon dbyangs bsnyen gyim bu dang / klu grub ye shes snying po dang / rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs bka'o // zhang zhung stong rgyung mthu' chen gyis / bod skad du bsgyur pa'o // klu rgyal bdud rtsi rin po [che]'i rgyud rdzogs s.ho // [smaller letters:] 'di bzhengs dge ba'i bsod nams gyis / nad mug mtshon gsum zhi ba dang / phan bde dngos grub thobs par shog / slar yang bod khams yongs bkra shis shog
item.note: the smaller letters at the end of the colophon are a prayer of good wishes by the person who had the volume made. the present text might possibly be identified with a five-chapter text listed at brgyud rim, p. 223, with the title rnam dag rin po che gtsang ma'i klu 'bum klu rgyal bdud rtsi rin po che'i rgyud. this seems much more likely when compared with the colophon title found in our text: klu rgyal bdud rtsi rin po [che]'i rgyud.
